pages.text: Choose borderless, flat, simple, middle, or fancy frames. Right-click an empty frame with a painted canvas. Right-click the filled frame with an empty hand to edit. Sneak-right-click to remove its canvas.
Adjacent borderless frames on the same plane join automatically.
Flat is one of the four bordered styles.
Each style comes in the vanilla woods and in framed form.
Use a single frame for a small piece or join multiple frames.
Fancy frames inherit the panel from the base frame.

pages.title: Build a Mural
pages.text: Place frames edge to edge in the same plane. Sneak-drill two neighbors to join them, or repeat the pair to separate them. Use an ordinary drill click to rotate the artwork.

pages.title: Lay Out the Image
pages.text: In the frame editor, set the master corner and choose the image scale, resolution, aspect, and rotation. Hide the borderless frame to reveal just the picture. When you mine a filled frame, collect the canvas and frame separately.
